name: Holographic
author: Ambrotype
description: Rainbow foil over the photo, like a hologram sticker or an oil slick: bands of colour that run across it and bend with its light, strongest in the bright parts.

params.name: bands
params.label: Bands
params.description: How many rainbows fit across the photo.

params.name: angle
params.label: Angle
params.description: Which way the bands run, in degrees.

params.name: follow
params.label: Follows the light
params.description: How much the bands bend with the photo's brightness: 0 is straight stripes, 100 is an oil slick.
